issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'ουκ εγενετο ναι και ου αλλα ναι εν αυτω γεγονεν' is a complex theological statement about the nature of 'Yes' and 'No' (the fulfillment of God's word) in Christ. The Vietnamese translation renders this as a literal quote about the words 'phải' (yes) and 'chẳng' (no), which strips the Greek of its conceptual meaning regarding the fulfillment of divine promises/judgments.
The Vietnamese fails to capture the nuance of 'gegonen' (has become/has happened) in relation to the fulfillment of the 'Yes' and 'No' in Christ.
